blockers.statement: CP-0030 accepts only the BF16 SiluAndMul activation/multiply subgate. Gate/up and down GEMM, every complete 15-contract model runtime gate, a complete layer, PyTorch/vLLM execution, and the full model remain unaccepted.

The inherited CP-0029 schema-8 manifest pins the older gem5 binary. CP-0030 uses the inherited compiler/runtime/plugin authority with an explicitly superseding gem5 execution input; it must not be represented as a fresh live schema-8 verify-only pass.

changes: Added a normal Python BF16 SiluAndMul runner for exact Qwen3.5 decode and masked-prefill shapes with finite-value, tolerance, tail-preservation, and zero-fallback oracles.
Added exact SiluAndMul image/descriptor/shape admission, BF16-aware memory and PC coverage, finite-output preflight, reusable D2H lifecycle evidence, and bounded bridge routing in gem5.
Corrected the canonical kernel's required packed BF16/F32 and divide-FMA semantics and added focused decoder, dtype, route, code-object, and pure semantic regression tests.
Executed fresh and repeat normal-Triton runs with zero mismatch/nonfinite/fallback, then revalidated CP26 gpuReadWrite, CP27 installed OpenCL, and CP29 normal Triton vecadd on the final binary.
Built with persistent ccache, Clang, LLD, and -j24 while retaining the compatible VEGA_X86 build tree and caches; removed only misplaced generated evidence from the child source tree.
limitations: The accepted image is exactly 6672 bytes with SHA-256 2db0d67ff6903a737f3a4d40cf67e2a2cbbacc8b605863d31b7c90386ccb357e, kernel silu_and_mul_kernel, BF16 decode [1,7168] to [1,3584], masked-prefill [7,7168] to [7,3584], BLOCK_SIZE 1024, and four programs per row.

SiluAndMul is only the elementwise activation/multiply inside mlp.gate_up_silu_down. Both projection GEMMs and the complete MLP contract remain false; complete model runtime coverage is 0/15 even though one internal subgate now passes.

Only the exact base-pointer dense BF16 layouts and finite input/output domain are accepted. Other shapes, dtypes, strides, storage offsets, aliases, mutations, and special-value behavior remain unproven.
The VOP corrections are bounded by focused tests and the canonical end-to-end kernel. Complete VOP3/VOP3P encoding, mode, denormal, modifier, and IEEE conformance is not claimed.

The accepted CP-0029 schema-8 prefix remains compiler/runtime/plugin authority, but its manifest pins the older CP-0029 gem5 binary. The CP-0030 gem5 binary is a superseding external execution input and CP-0029 live verify-only is not claimed after this child update.
No complete Qwen operator contract, layer, official PyTorch/vLLM path, full model, stable multi-token decode, tensor parallelism, CCL, profiling, or performance result is accepted.

argv: Expand the Qwen3.5 operator manifest into an executable per-op work queue and accept the next bounded BF16 RMSNorm differential subgate through normal Triton
next_action.expected: CP-0031 will add executable dtype/shape/stride/mutation/state/tolerance/dependency records to the model operator work queue and compile/execute the exact BF16 Qwen3.5 RMSNorm decode and masked-prefill shapes through normal Triton with a differential oracle, exact trace, deterministic repeat, and zero fallback. It will preserve CP26/CP27/CP29/CP30 regressions and will not claim a complete RMSNorm contract, layer, or model unless every required variant is directly proven.
prerequisites: CP-0030, EV-0068, BL-0109, and BL-0110 are accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.

Gem5 is clean at 8bf4f3eeec45c5f63e7529dfeff37383b3e3a998 / 74d5b144a810dc86d298b262b99fdb18fc9801e9; the schema-8 compiler/runtime/plugin prefix remains inherited authority, with the CP-0030 gem5 binary explicitly superseding its older managed-input hash.
The 15-contract Qwen manifest remains static-source-only and complete runtime coverage remains 0/15; SiluAndMul is recorded only as a bounded internal subgate.
Any project build uses -j24; LLVM/Triton builds additionally use persistent ccache, /usr/bin/clang, /usr/bin/ld.lld, and compatible retained build/cache trees.
The next accepted operator gate must retain a normal Python launch, application-visible differential oracle, exact simulator trace, zero CPU/NVIDIA fallback, and CP26/CP27/CP29/CP30 regressions.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0030 accepted only at the exact BF16 SiluAndMul subgate. If the executable work-queue schema or RMSNorm image/ABI/oracle/trace/no-fallback gate cannot be proven, do not weaken exact image admission, reuse host arithmetic, mark any complete 15-contract entry passed, or claim a layer/model result.
